jobPostings.jobDescription:
Location: Remote somewhere in EuropeJob Overview
We are looking for an experienced, structured Project Manager with 6 to 9 years in the role to run the rollout, integration and improvement of our ERP platform, our AI projects and the wider set of business applications.
 
You will be the link between engineers, data scientists and the business. You will lead delivery of large software programmes from start to finish and make sure the systems fit where the company is going and grow with it. Knowing Salesforce helps, but it is not required.
 
Key Responsibilities

Project Lifecycle Management: Run application projects from scope and requirements through design, build, UAT, go-live and support after launch.
ERP & Systems Integration: Plan, configure and roll out ERP modules and connect them to the internal applications people already use, so daily work runs more smoothly.
AI Solution Delivery: Work with data science and engineering to bring AI-based tools, automation and models into everyday operations.
